description: Dispatch an ONNX benchmark to one of the customer's connected devices (Jetson, Snapdragon host, gateway) by name/id. The on-device agent picks it up within ~30s and reports latency/memory results. Multi-silicon: works for any vendor the customer has connected. Requires admin role.

device.description: Device to run on: DB UUID, agent device_id, or the exact display name from edgegate_list_device_targets.

model_artifact_id.description: ONNX model artifact in this workspace.

model_name.description: Label for the result; defaults to the artifact filename.

name: edgegate_run_device_benchmark
